assumptions_left_unpromoted: That the numerical inconsistency costs enquiries. Plausible, untested, and not scored.
That the ISO claim is unsubstantiated rather than merely undocumented on the site.
That an absent form in a text fetch means an absent or broken form.
limitations_carried: Social platforms were not opened. LinkedIn and Instagram links exist on the homepage but follower counts, last-post dates and content quality were not retrieved.
No review platform, Google Maps listing or press mention was queried.
Response-time and uptime commitments (24 hours, under 2 hours emergency, 99 percent uptime) are the company's own published claims. None was independently tested.
Mobile readiness, page speed and technical health were not measured and are not inferred here.
unknowns_carried: Whether 5,000+ or 500+ is the accurate project figure.
Whether the ISO claim is current, and under which standard and scope.
Whether the enquiry form renders and confirms correctly for a real visitor.
Who owns the enquiry route internally.

corrections_to_prior_evidence.corrects: This directly corrects the earlier engine research, which read the SPOTA text as stray placeholder residue beside the quote route.

proposed_transition_receipt.enforcement_note: Built with enforce=False because the diagnostic_selected receipt lives in runs/, which Codex owns and which this runtime does not write. Every gate was still evaluated and every one passed. Codex must confirm the diagnostic_selected receipt exists before persisting this.

route_confirmation.basis: approved diagnostic findings only, weighted by severity
route_confirmation.reason: The audit changed the problem, not the route. The original basis was a reading of the SPOTA navigation text as placeholder residue at the quote path; ca-arc-4 verified that text is a deliberate Coming Soon label and withdrew that basis. Four approved website_trust and conversion_path findings replace it, led by ca-arc-1: the homepage and the mission page publish project and client counts that differ by an order of magnitude. Owned-surface credibility is the same route, reached by different evidence.

entry_offer_hypotheses.hypothesis: A claims reconciliation pass across owned pages: one verified set of figures for projects, clients, staff and coverage, applied everywhere they appear.
entry_offer_hypotheses.why_it_is_credible: The inconsistency is verified on their own pages, visible to any buyer who reads two of them, and cheap to fix.
entry_offer_hypotheses.what_would_kill_it: If they already know which figure is right and simply have not updated the page, this is a ten-minute edit, not an engagement.
entry_offer_hypotheses.evidence_still_missing: Which figure is accurate. Not knowable from outside.

entry_offer_hypotheses.hypothesis: Substantiate the ISO claim on the site: standard, scope, issuing body and validity, presented where procurement looks for it.
entry_offer_hypotheses.why_it_is_credible: They sell to Dangote, Providus and Cummins. Those buyers run vendor due diligence, and an unsubstantiated certification claim is a procurement risk rather than a marketing one.
entry_offer_hypotheses.what_would_kill_it: If no certificate exists, this becomes a compliance conversation and BridgeWorks should not run it.
entry_offer_hypotheses.evidence_still_missing: Whether a certificate exists at all.

entry_offer_hypotheses.hypothesis: Enquiry-route integrity check: confirm the form renders, submits, confirms to the visitor and lands with a named owner inside the 24-hour promise they publish.
entry_offer_hypotheses.why_it_is_credible: They publish a 24-hour quote commitment against a single generic inbox with no named owner. The commitment is public; the mechanism behind it is not observable.
entry_offer_hypotheses.what_would_kill_it: A working form and a real owner. Then there is no problem.
entry_offer_hypotheses.evidence_still_missing: Everything behind the form. Not testable without submitting one, which is an external action and is not authorised.
entry_offer_hypotheses.hard_constraint: Testing this by submitting the form would be contact. Not done.

stop_point: item 7: no outreach preparation, no approval packet
